name: yvoke
description: Playbook-scoped, cited answers from the Yvoke knowledge base, with multi-agent review.

serverUrl.title: Yvoke server URL
serverUrl.description: The Yvoke MCP endpoint, for example http://localhost:8080/mcp for a yvoke-web running on this machine.

devMode.title: Dev mode (local yvoke-web only)
devMode.description: On: connect without signing in, to a local yvoke-web running in mock mode. Off: the normal sign-in, for any other server.

showPrototypes.title: Show prototype areas and playbooks
showPrototypes.description: On: the Yvoke setup band also offers areas and playbooks the server marks as prototypes.

turnLimitSingle.title: Turn limit, single agent
turnLimitSingle.description: The most model requests a single-agent Yvoke question may make. At the limit the model is told to answer with what it has, and the answer is marked as stopped at the turn limit. 0 turns the limit off.

turnLimitLead.title: Turn limit, lead (multi-agent)
turnLimitLead.description: The most model requests the lead may make for one question in a multi-agent Yvoke session. 0 turns the limit off.

turnLimitAgent.title: Turn limit, specialists and reviewer
turnLimitAgent.description: The most model requests each specialist or reviewer run may make. At the limit it reports what it has found so far. 0 turns the limit off.
